title: never works, various error messages: G6 SENSOR FAILED, G6 Start Failed; No signal
symptom: The app never works reliably, showing various errors like G6 SENSOR FAILED, G6 Start Failed, No signal, and calibration rejected. The user has tried multiple troubleshooting steps, and it only worked for about a day before failing.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It suggests that some transmitters with serial starting with 81 may not work with preemptive restarts, but this is contradicted by another user. The issue remains unresolved.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. One user suggests turning off preemptive restarts, and another suggests turning off OB1 mode and using it like a G5, but these are not confirmed. The issue was closed due to inactivity.
evidence_quote: Turning off preemptive restarts fixed it for me. Try it and see if it will work. I guess some of the transmitters work with it and some do not
